Marcus / Monica,

I reviewed the staging traces and the ask. Operationally we can scale a hosted pool to absorb a 3.2k QPS peak for a 6-hour window, but it will push a few customers in the same shard toward lower headroom. Two pricing options we typically offer:

- Option A (Provisional uplift, hosted): one-time surge fee = $5,200 (flat) + temporary per-token uplift of +40% to standard paygo for that window. No change to monthly commit; any usage beyond commit is billed at the uplifted rate.
- Option B (Short Dedicated burst): reserved short-term capacity (best p99) — $12,000 reserved for the day with 20% discount on per-token rates for usage within that reserved bucket. Any usage outside the reserved bucket billed at normal overrun rates.

We can also do a hybrid: provisional hosted uplift with a capped backcharge agreement where we agree a capped retro true-up for any measured overrun up to a pre-agreed cap (helps buyers avoid surprise bills). For BrightCart given the staging numbers, I recommend Option A with a capped backcharge of $8k. That means BrightCart pays the $5,200 surge fee + uplifted per-token for the window, and if total overrun exceeds estimated staging delta we cap additional retro true-up to $8k.

Operational lead time: 24 hours to guarantee, 6–12 hours as best-effort. We need the exact UTC window by EOD tomorrow to lock the pool.

Attaching a provisional-pricing-sheet.xlsx (stub) with cost math.

Ben Carter
Director, Accounts — Redwood Inference

Elena — moving to confirm details from ops side. A few operational notes / asks:

- Please confirm exact UTC start/end. You mentioned Dec 15 in your first note; is this 00:00–06:00 UTC or another window?
- Provide an IP CIDR allowlist for any callbacks so we can open network paths if you require tighter routing.
- If you want guaranteed p99 we recommend the short dedicated burst; otherwise hosted surge will be best-effort and we will add an automatic fallback to the next-compatible model if capacity tightens.

If you accept Ben's Option A + capped backcharge, our workflow will be:
1) BrightCart signs a short addendum (DocuSign link included).
2) We lock the surge provision 24h prior.
3) Post-window we provide a 72h reconciliation report + applied charges and carry out the capped true-up if relevant.
